section: Race summaries > Round 15 – Japan Suzuka International Racing Course

entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Victim of a dramatic first corner clash, spinning out when he made contact with Kimi Räikkönen.

entities.name: Kimi Räikkönen
entities.description: Involved in a first corner clash with Fernando Alonso.

entities.name: Mark Webber
entities.description: Caught up in the opening lap melee when hit by Romain Grosjean.

entities.name: Romain Grosjean
entities.description: Hit Mark Webber in the opening lap and received a ten-second stop-go penalty.

entities.name: Bruno Senna
entities.description: Hit Nico Rosberg while trying to avoid Grosjean and Webber, earning a drive-through penalty.

entities.name: Nico Rosberg
entities.description: Retired from the race after being hit by Bruno Senna.

entities.name: Sergio Pérez
entities.description: Retired early after sliding off at the hairpin.

entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Struggling during the race when Sergio Pérez slid off trying to pass him.

entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Won the race from pole position, leading every lap and setting the fastest lap time.

entities.name: 2012 Formula One World Championship
entities.description: The championship season in which the race took place.

entities.name: Japan Suzuka International Racing Course
entities.description: The circuit where the race was held.

entities.name: Grand Chelem
entities.description: Achieved by Sebastian Vettel for winning the race from pole position, leading every lap, and setting the fastest lap.

relationships.description: Sebastian Vettel won the race achieving a Grand Chelem.
The Grand Chelem title belongs to the 2012 Formula One World Championship season.
